summary: Voice memo to short scripts: a recording in, the shorts it holds out, three versions each, read aloud, two or three feedbacks, the lead magnet checked.

prerequisites.label: Speech-to-text (Whisper, on your Mac's GPU)
prerequisites.hint: Installed on first run by the video engine's bootstrap.

prerequisites.label: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (each version read aloud)
prerequisites.hint: elevenlabs.io › Developers › API keys. Billed by ElevenLabs per character read. Without it, the versions are there to read.
prerequisites.does: Reads each version of your scripts aloud, so you hear it instead of reading it.
prerequisites.without: You get the same scripts, to read: nothing is read aloud. Your memo is transcribed on your Mac either way.
prerequisites.cost: Billed by ElevenLabs per character read: a version is about 600 characters. Any plan.
